method: Exhaustive case-insensitive keyword sweep of app/, routes/, database/, tests/, config/, resources/ (vendor/ and node_modules/ excluded via .gitignore). Classification is semantic, not lexical: several Creative-adjacent words exist in this repository with a completely different advertising meaning.

headline.conclusion: Creative Marketplace is 100% greenfield. There is no partial implementation, no dead code, no half-built aggregate, and no reserved table name. Everything must be newly built.
